# International Campfire Talks

The International Campfire Talks series serves to connect members of Scouting
America to other National Scouting Organizations (NSOs) via our [Facebook
Page](https://www.facebook.com/International.BSA) and
[YouTube.](https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCNVUk6qCJJ-N36d92gV901g?view_as=subscriber)
Listen and watch as we navigate the six different WOSM Regions.

Learn about the latest International Campfire Talks and watch old videos on
our [YouTube Channel.
](https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCNVUk6qCJJ-N36d92gV901g/featured)

## Arab Scout Region

Join us for our International Campfire Talk as we explore the Arab Scout
Region and have special guests, Nour from Algeria 🇩🇿and Nadine from Tunisia
🇹🇳!

## Asia-Pacific Scout Region

Join us for our International Campfire Talks series as we learn about Scouting
in Singapore 🇸🇬 and the Philippines 🇵🇭!



Celeste is a Scout from the Boy Scouts of the Philippines. Wei Yung is a rover
scout from The Singapore Scout Association and serves as the Chairman of the
Scouting in the Asia-Pacific Region Youth Representatives. ⚜️



## African Scout Region

Join us for our International Campfire Talk as we visit the African Scout
Region and have special guest, Marie-Annick N’si Nguessan from Cote d’Ivoire
(Ivory Coast) 🇨🇮.

Join us for our International Campfire Talk as we visit the African Scout
Region and have a special guest, Mthabisi Titus Dhlamini, from Zimbabwe 🇿🇼.

## European Scout Region

Expand your Scouting horizons by learning about Scouting in different
Countries around our virtual International campfire 🔥.

In August we visited Scouts from the European Scout Region, and had special
guests Marta from Spain 🇪🇸 and Caillum from Ireland 🇨🇮.

Learn about Scouting programs in other Countries/National Scouting
Organizations as well as culture, foods, and much more. Scouts can earn credit
for the Citizenship in the World Merit Badge requirement 7c.



## Interamerican Scout Region

On July 26th we visited the Interamerican Scout Region with special guests
Jimena from Peru 🇵🇪 and Lucas from Brazil 🇧🇷. Watch the video to learn more!
